sources.summary: Rise in fatalities comes amid news reports that the average age of Burning Man attenders is increasing Three men over 50 died at Burning Man this year, tripling the average number of deaths in connection with the annual festival that brings tens of thousands of people to build a temporary utopian community in the brutal conditions of the Nevada desert. The increase in fatalities comes as news reports have highlighted that the average age of Burning Man attenders is increasing, with fewer participants in their 20s, and more in their 40s and 50s.
